_comment: Paste the 'mag-hrn' block into your Claude Desktop config under mcpServers. Restart Claude Desktop after editing. Leave MAG_HRN_FEATURE_SERVICE_URL empty to run against the canned ~12-site dataset (safe to demo without hitting MAG infrastructure); set it to the active MAG ArcGIS service root (typically https://geo.azmag.gov/arcgis/rest/services/maps/Heat_Relief_Network/MapServer or .../FeatureServer) to switch to live data.
